justification: Adds a deterministic, model-free page proof for served council DCP rows that DQ-145 still counts (283 rows with page_check not_found/unresolved/too_short). New scripts only: a matcher module, a plan generator that is read-only on the database, an independent verifier, and an apply script that is a dry run unless --apply is passed. Nothing is applied in this PR; no production write, no change to dq_checks.json or to any served path.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_page_evidence.py -q && python scripts/verify_page_evidence.py data/page_evidence_2026-10-17.jsonl --db
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A matcher accepts a span that is not printed, or the verifier accepts a tampered proof. Measured on this branch: mutating find_span's word-boundary test, the one-page-only rule, the MIN_WORDS rule, the verifier's offset comparison and the header+row reading each turned at least one test red (1 failed each). The verifier was fed a tampered copy of three real lines (offset shifted, wrong sha256, wrong page) and rejected all three with exit 1; the untouched file verifies 100/100 against the pinned PDFs and the live provision_text md5s.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: The chapter PDFs themselves, pinned by sha256 and re-read by PyMuPDF in the verifier; and the live provision_text md5 for each row. Neither the matcher's own output nor a model is consulted by the verifier.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Watched red on this branch, 2026-10-17. Mutation: removing the one-page-only rule in prove() printed '1 failed, 5 passed' (test_text_run_on_two_pages_is_unresolved). Removing the MIN_WORDS rule printed '1 failed, 7 passed'. Removing the verifier's offset comparison printed '1 failed, 14 passed'. Removing the word-boundary test printed '1 failed, 7 passed' after test_span_ending_mid_word_is_not_a_match was added. Tampered JSONL of three real lines: verify_page_evidence printed 'FAIL id=131843: start/end do not frame the span', 'FAIL id=131985: pdf sha256 99377f918fe4 != recorded 000000000000', 'FAIL id=131986: page text at the recorded offsets is not the span', 'verified 0/3 proofs' and exited 1.

pre_impl.existing_data: scripts/dcp_page_repair.py and scripts/rule_page_locator.py already judge pages with a half-match tolerance (HOLD 0.5) that cannot say which words matched where. regulatory_provisions has no evidence column (migration 079 adds pdf_page, page_range, printed_page_label, page_check, page_checked_at, page_source_path only), so evidence is a committed JSONL keyed by id + md5 and the apply path reuses dcp_page_repair.plan_row/backup/write unchanged.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed the large Ashfield group (heritage Part 9 street tables) would be rows of a table. They are COLUMNS of a table (one repeated street or style name per line), so a row-only table matcher would have proved none of them; the matcher reads rows, columns and header+one data row.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New module page_evidence.py because the existing locator is score-based; it is used only on rows the locator left unresolved. dcp_page_repair is imported, not modified.

functions.name: prove
functions.input: the rule's normalised words and every page's text and table readings
functions.output: (proven, evidence, info) when the whole span is on exactly one page; otherwise unresolved / not_found / too_short with the rival pages
functions.if_none: an empty or sub-3-word rule returns too_short and no evidence; a PDF with no readable page returns not_found

functions.name: check_evidence
functions.input: one evidence dict and the fitz page it names
functions.output: a list of problems; empty only when the recorded offsets hold exactly the recorded span on that page
functions.if_none: missing span, offsets, table index, or a merged/None cell each return a problem rather than passing

proofs would be unverified by anything but the code that made them

queries.query: DQ-145 council subset (is_current AND v2_is_actionable, not TOC, source_council NOT NULL, not inner_west_lep, citation_status not proven/imprecise, page_check not on_page/moved)
queries.scope: regulatory_provisions joined to dcp_chapter_registry on the active row
queries.filters: is_current, v2_is_actionable, is_active; read-only session; 30s statement timeout
queries.purpose: List the served council DCP rows DQ-145 counts as unproven, with their chapter PDF path, so each can be re-read against its PDF.
queries.where_clause: rp.is_current AND rp.v2_is_actionable AND source_council IS NOT NULL AND source_council <> 'inner_west_lep' AND NOT (citation_status IN ('proven','imprecise') OR page_check IN ('on_page','moved'))

break_it.scenario: The same words are printed on two pages (a control restated per site, or a contents page plus the body).
break_it.what_happens: The row is reported unresolved with both pages and receives no evidence.
break_it.how: prove() requires exactly one matching page across all readings; test_text_run_on_two_pages_is_unresolved fails if that rule is removed (mutation run).

break_it.scenario: A rule ends mid-word of the printed text (setback vs setbacks).
break_it.what_happens: No match; spans must start and end on word boundaries.
break_it.how: find_span boundary test; test_span_ending_mid_word_is_not_a_match fails when the boundary check is removed (mutation run).

break_it.scenario: Evidence is edited after the fact (offset, page, sha256, cell list, table index).
break_it.what_happens: The verifier re-reads the pinned PDF and exits 1.
break_it.how: tampered copy of three real lines rejected; unit tests tamper each field.
break_it.repro: python scripts/verify_page_evidence.py <copy of data/page_evidence_2026-10-17.jsonl with one line's evidence.start incremented> ; echo $?

break_it.scenario: provision_text changes, the row is proven by someone else, or the chapter PDF is republished between plan and apply.
break_it.what_happens: apply_page_evidence refuses the whole file and writes nothing.
break_it.how: preflight() compares md5, current page_check and r2_current_path per line; unit-tested; --apply also checks the written rowcount equals the line count.

mutation_analysis: Six mutations run against the new tests: word-boundary check removed (initially survived, because the fixture differed on the next word as well; test_span_ending_mid_word_is_not_a_match was added and now kills it), one-page-only rule removed (killed), MIN_WORDS rule removed (killed), verifier offset comparison removed (killed), header+row reading widened to a second row (killed), merged-cell None check removed (survives, an equivalent mutant: the empty-cell check on the next line rejects the same input).
residual_risk: A short span (3 to 6 words) that is printed on exactly one page is accepted, for example a diagram label or a heading; it proves the words are on that page, not that the page is where the council states the control. Columns are read with empty cells skipped, so a column of generic style names matched at four non-adjacent cells (id 244169, moved p260 to p66) is a weaker claim than a prose run; it is labelled table-cells with the exact cells so a reviewer can see it. 183 of the 283 rows remain unproven: contents-page fragments, map and figure labels, interleaved table cells and figure captions that no PDF text layer prints contiguously. Nothing is applied here; applying needs the user's go.

post_merge.db_reset: No. Read-only against the database; apply_page_evidence is a dry run unless --apply is passed.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run python scripts/apply_page_evidence.py data/page_evidence_2026-10-17.jsonl (dry run) and open 5 proofs' pdf pages before any --apply.
